events.title: Georgia Chapter Installation
events.description: A new CALUNAH chapter was established in Atlanta, Georgia, growing our reach across the states and carrying on the mission and vision of CALUNAH through a Meet & Greet luncheon.
events.fullInfo: As a nonprofit organization, CALUNAH believes in growing and reaching out to all alumni around the states. A new chapter was officially established on February 22, 2025 at Ebenezer SDA Church in Atlanta, Georgia, with the ultimate goal to carry on the Mission and Vision of CALUNAH. The installation was celebrated through a Meet & Greet amid a luncheon, welcoming alumni in the Georgia area into the CALUNAH family.

events.title: 3-Day Prayer Session for Haiti
events.description: CALUNAH lifted up heartfelt prayers for Haiti, for peace, healing, and strength in the midst of hardship. Three nights of intercession uniting all chapters in one voice before God.
events.fullInfo: As uncertainty was being faced among Haitian immigrants, CALUNAH launched a three-day Prayer Session with the participation of all chapters, calling on God for Forgiveness & Reconciliation (Wednesday), Physical, Emotional & Spiritual Healing (Thursday), and Protection & Deliverance (Friday). 📍 Via Zoom · Meeting ID: 898 1400 5387 · Passcode: prayers · "The prayer of a righteous person is powerful and effective." – James 5:16.

events.title: Backpack Drive Community Service
events.description: CALUNAH launched a Backpack Drive Community Service event just before school opened, taking place simultaneously across all chapters on the same day, reaching out a hand to children in need across different states.
events.fullInfo: It was a great success where hundreds and hundreds of backpacks were given to different communities. A smile was surely put on many children's faces, and a burden lifted upon many parents getting ready for back to school. The event took place simultaneously through the participation of all chapters, on the same day, in different states, uniting CALUNAH in one powerful act of service.

events.title: Saturday Giving Event
events.description: Our community came together for the Saturday Giving Event, a heartfelt initiative raising funds for student scholarships, campus maintenance, building upgrades, new computers, and essential resources that enhance learning and growth.
events.fullInfo: On November 30, 2024, CALUNAH Executive presented the Saturday Giving Event broadcast live on YouTube and Facebook. The event raised funds for: Scholarships · Renovation & Maintenance · Monitors / Computers · and much more. Thanks to the incredible generosity of donors, partners, and volunteers, the event made a lasting impact that will continue to benefit our school community for years to come.

events.title: Spring Fundraising Gala 2023
events.description: An unforgettable evening of elegance, unity, and purpose. Alumni from across the chapters gathered in Lauderhill, FL, under the theme "Building for the Future", raising vital funds for UNAH student scholarships and campus excellence.
events.fullInfo:
On March 26, 2023, CALUNAH hosted its Spring Fundraising Gala in Lauderhill, Florida, a landmark evening that brought together alumni, sponsors, and friends of UNAH from across the diaspora. Under the inspiring theme "Building for the Future," the gala celebrated the enduring legacy of l'Université Adventiste d'Haïti while raising vital funds for student scholarships, campus improvements, and essential educational resources.

The ballroom glowed with elegance and community spirit. Keynote addresses moved the room to action, heartfelt tributes honored those who have given so much, and spirited fundraising reflected a community united by one powerful belief: that education has the power to transform lives and rebuild nations.

Every dollar donated, every table filled, every story shared that night became part of a living legacy, one that continues to open doors for the next generation of UNAH graduates. This was more than a gala. It was a declaration that no matter where life has carried us, we remain rooted in faith, united in mission, and committed to building a brighter future, together.

events.title: Annual Fundraising Gala 2024
events.location: Holy Trinity Reception Center, Maitland, FL
events.description: An incredible evening of community, purpose, and impact. Alumni gathered at Holy Trinity Reception Center under the theme "Aiming Higher for a Better UNAH", with inspiring performances, a sumptuous dinner, and a spirited silent auction that raised vital funds for UNAH education.
events.fullInfo:
On June 9, 2024, CALUNAH hosted its Annual Fundraising Gala at the Holy Trinity Reception Center in Maitland, Florida, under the theme "Aiming Higher for a Better UNAH." The atmosphere was buzzing as guests arrived, each bringing their energy and enthusiasm to a beautifully decorated venue set for a night of inspiring stories, heartfelt moments, and amazing performances.

The highlight of the evening was the performance by special guests whose incredible voices, musical talents, and captivating presence inspired the audience, emphasizing the power of art and storytelling in driving change. Guests then enjoyed a sumptuous dinner showcasing the culinary talents of local chefs, where conversations flowed freely and laughter echoed around the tables.

The silent auction featured an array of unique items and experiences, from a luxury weekend getaway to private chef dinners and signed sports memorabilia. Guests bid with extraordinary generosity, some items fetching over 200% of their value. Every bid placed, every story shared, and every connection made that night became part of a living legacy.

We extend our deepest gratitude to our sponsors, donors, attendees, and dedicated volunteers. Your support ensures that our mission to uplift UNAH education continues to grow and thrive. Together, we are not just a community, we are a force for good.
